scalars.scalar_value: At least two (2) years of relevant experience in digital production, digitization, digital collections, digital publishing, photography, or a related field, including experience managing digital assets and workflows, creating and maintaining documentation, and applying established standards and procedures to the production of digital content.

items.item_text: At least two (2) years of relevant experience in digital production, digitization, digital collections, digital publishing, photography, or a related field, including experience managing digital assets and workflows, creating and maintaining documentation, and applying established standards and procedures to the production of digital content.

Participates in digital production and publishing workflows for the Claremont Colleges Digital Library (CCDL) and Scholarship@Claremont, with a keen attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality, consistency, accessibility, and long-term digital preservation.

Performs quality control of digitized and born-digital content, including imaging, post-processing, audiovisual content, optical character recognition (OCR), metadata, file management, and other digital production activities in accordance with established workflows and standards, including applicable FADGI standards.
Participates in the digital collections lifecycle, from digitization and metadata creation through content ingest, publishing, and digital asset management.

Supports the Open Publishing Applications Specialist (OPAS) in open publishing production work, including managing the submission of content, creating metadata, designing and documenting workflows, monitoring and ensuring the quality of data, and tracking projects through the publication process.
Maintain close and effective communication and reporting on digitization and asset ingest, production issues, and project activities with the Head of Digital Initiatives and Open Publishing.

Supports the production and management of video and audio recordings, including AV reformatting and transcription workflows, such as generating, reviewing, correcting and preparing machine-generated transcripts to enhance accessibility and support their use in digital collections and publishing workflows.
Responds to email inquiries submitted to the Digital Initiatives LibAnswers queue.
Oversee scan-on-demand processes including coordination with related units.

Provides training and guidance to student assistants supporting digitization, scan-on-demand, and audiovisual projects and communicate any issues to the Head of Digital Initiatives and Open Publishing in a timely manner.
Assigns and monitors student work and provides training in digitization equipment, imaging, post-processing, quality control, metadata, content ingest, AV reformatting, and file management.
Track and report on project progress, milestones, and production outputs and communicate issues requiring supervisory attention.
Work collaboratively to make recommendations regarding digitization, metadata, quality control, and production workflows.
Perform other related duties as assigned
